decision: Drive through penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 2 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 41 overtook Car 10 in a double yellow flag sector
offence: Breach of Article B1.8.4b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Drive through penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 2 for the 12 month period).
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing and in-car video evidence. Car 41 was behind Car 10 entering Turn 14 and overtook Car 10 in the double yellow flag sector before the Line at the end of Lap 1. Normally such infringement requires a 10 second stop/go penalty, but the Stewards acknowledge the complications caused by the significant amount of debris on track at this point and take this into account as mitigating circumstances.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
